name: Cap Screen Recording and Sharing
description: Record and share screen videos with links and comments. Loom alternative.

upstream.version: cap-web latest @ sha256:8ee4cbd3 (built 2026-09-07); cap-media-server latest @ sha256:2dc90e05 (built 2026-10-10)

Cap.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "i=0; until nc -w 3 $MYSQL_WAIT_HOST 3306 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge 150 ]; then echo 'MySQL not reachable after 5 minutes'; exit 1; fi; echo 'waiting for MySQL'; sleep 2; done; HOSTNAME=:: exec node apps/web/server.js"

PORT.description: Port the Next.js server listens on; Railway routes traffic and healthchecks here.

WEB_URL.description: Public URL of this Cap instance (share links, desktop app sign-in, OAuth callbacks). Change it when you add a custom domain.

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Must equal WEB_URL; NextAuth builds its callback URLs from it.

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Signs session tokens (32 random bytes, hex). Changing it signs everyone out.

DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32-byte hex key that encrypts stored credentials (e.g. a user's own S3 keys). Never change it after first boot.

DATABASE_URL.description: MySQL connection string over the private network (Cap requires MySQL).

MYSQL_WAIT_HOST.description: Host the start command waits for before booting; Cap migrates on boot and gives up after three quick attempts.

CAP_AWS_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores recordings, thumbnails and exports.

S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint used in the presigned URLs browsers and the desktop app upload to and play from.

S3_INTERNAL_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint for server-side calls (Railway Buckets have no private endpoint, so it equals the public one).

S3_PATH_STYLE.description: Use path-style bucket URLs (Cap's default for non-AWS storage). Keep true: browser uploads depend on the bucket CORS rule set by Bucket CORS.

MEDIA_SERVER_URL.description: Private address of the ffmpeg media server.

MEDIA_SERVER_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Shared secret for media-server progress callbacks; Cap Media Server references it.

MEDIA_SERVER_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Private address the media server calls back to (works because the start command binds to ::).

CRON_SECRET.description: Bearer token for Cap's maintenance endpoints; Cap Maintenance references it.

CAP_VIDEOS_DEFAULT_PUBLIC.description: New recordings are viewable by anyone with the link (upstream default). Set false to make them private until shared.

CAP_ALLOWED_SIGNUP_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated e-mail domains allowed to sign up, e.g. yourcompany.com. Empty = anyone who can receive the login code.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key for login-code and notification e-mails (HTTP API, works on every Railway plan). Without it, login codes are printed to this service's logs.

RESEND_FROM_DOMAIN.description: Domain verified in Resend that e-mails are sent from, e.g. yourcompany.com.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Google OAuth client ID for 'Sign in with Google' (callback: WEB_URL/api/auth/callback/google).

ASSEMBLY_API_KEY.description: Optional AssemblyAI key: automatic transcription and captions.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional Groq key: AI titles, summaries and chapters (preferred generation provider).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenAI key: AI features fallback.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional Anthropic key: AI chat features.

PORT.description: Port the media server listens on (Bun binds [::], dual-stack); used for the healthcheck.

MEDIA_SERVER_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Shared with Cap: references Cap.MEDIA_SERVER_WEBHOOK_SECRET (edit it there).

MEDIA_SERVER_WEB_ORIGIN.description: Cap's public origin; lets the media server fetch media through Cap's storage proxy with the shared secret.

MYSQLUSER.description: MySQL user, used for the Data panel.

MYSQLDATABASE.description: Default database, used for Data panel.

MYSQLPASSWORD.description: Root password, used for Data panel.

MYSQL_DATABASE.description: Database created on first boot; Cap's DATABASE_URL points at it.

MYSQL_USER.description: Application user created on first boot with full rights on MYSQL_DATABASE.

MYSQL_PASSWORD.description: Password of the application user (letters and digits only, it is embedded in a URL).

Bucket CORS.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "aws s3api put-bucket-cors --bucket $BUCKET_NAME --endpoint-url $S3_ENDPOINT --region $S3_REGION --cors-configuration \"$CORS_CONFIGURATION\" && echo 'Bucket CORS configured for' $PUBLIC_ORIGIN"

PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: Cap's public origin (used in the log line).

CORS_CONFIGURATION.description: CORS rule letting browsers on Cap's domain upload (multipart, needs ETag) and play recordings via presigned URLs. Add custom domains to AllowedOrigins and redeploy this service.

Cap Maintenance.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "for job in recover-failed-video-processing finalize-stale-desktop-segments; do curl -sS --max-time 240 --retry 2 --retry-delay 10 --retry-connrefused -o /dev/null -w \"$job: HTTP %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET\" \"$CAP_INTERNAL_URL/api/cron/$job\"; done"

CRON_SECRET.description: Shared with Cap: references Cap.CRON_SECRET (edit it there).
